message.content:
**Analysis of the screenshot:**

1) **Dynamic dash pose?** ✅ Yes — the stickman is clearly airborne/mid-dash, body leaned far forward with legs trailing back, sword arm extended. Definitely not standing.

2) **Dark afterimage ghosts?** ⚠️ **No** — I don't see distinct dark ghost silhouettes trailing behind him. There are white/cyan speed streak lines behind the pose, but no faded dark copies of the body. This is the main missing element.

3) **Slash trail/ribbon or speed streaks?** ✅ **Yes** — a large glowing cyan blade/katana is extended horizontally with a bright edge, and white horizontal speed streak lines trail behind the player. However, the "ribbon" trail is fairly modest — the streaks are short white lines rather than a long continuous slash arc across the screen.

4) **Ground dust/debris?** ✅ **Yes** — there are gray dust/impact puffs on the ground beneath/behind the player, plus a faint reflection on the wet floor.

5) **HUD:** ✅ **Yes** — the stamina bar shows **480 / 600**, and the status line under it reads **"RECOVERING ... DASH 45 | POWER 120"** — consistent with a just-released charged move.

6) **Enemies / damage numbers?** ❌ **No** — no enemies visible (HUD confirms "WAVE 1 HOSTILES 0 KILLS 0"), no hit flashes or damage numbers. The move appears to have been fired into empty space.

7) **Overall:** It reads reasonably as a fast dash-slash — the forward-leaning airborne pose, glowing extended blade, speed streaks, dust puffs, and "RECOVERING" HUD sell the motion. To fully match the RAIJIN ZAN description, it needs: (a) **dark afterimage ghost silhouettes**, and (b) a **longer, more continuous slash trail ribbon** stretching across the dash path rather than just short streaks.
